description: Rebuilt 29-10-2026 from VATSIM Switzerland's vACC 'Preferential Runway System' page (vacc.ch), which gives exact runway pairs, local-time windows and a tailwind threshold, and matches a real LSZH arrival ATIS sample exactly -- unlike Zurich Airport's own 'Operating Concepts' page (used in the retracted first version of this pack), which only gave vague named concepts. Full sourcing, the ATIS cross-check and every simplification below are in docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md: GENERAL_NE/EVENING_NE are low-confidence (no threshold found, not seen in the one ATIS sample); settings.json's single tailwind limit (7 kt) is a stand-in for the vACC page's separate 10 kt (RWY14) / 7 kt (RWY28) figures, since the schema has no per-runway override; no crosswind threshold was found for any mode; atisWording is the project's generic default, not LSZH's real (free-text) ATIS style.

modes.description: Daytime default (vACC 'General'): arrivals 14, departures 28. Matches the live ATIS sample exactly.
Daytime, strong north-easterly wind (Zurich Airport's own page; not in the vACC page, no threshold found): arrivals 14, departures 10
Evening, strong north-easterly wind (Zurich Airport's own page; not in the vACC page, no threshold found): arrivals 34, departures 10

atisWording.source: project default -- the real ATIS sample uses 'ARRIVALS'/'DEP' and different sentence structure entirely (free text, not a runway/for/and template), so this field does not really apply to LSZH's ATIS style; kept for schema compatibility only
